args.reason: The supersession argument is sound: the old decision rested on an explicit premise (under 20 issues per run, simple single-writer atomicity) that has demonstrably lapsed (200+ issues, a parallel concurrency executor). The new design directly addresses the two concrete failure modes the old one cannot handle (one lock that every write contends on, and a single corrupt byte losing the whole run), keeps the same directory root, and adds an index for discovery. This is drift in the facts, not a reversal of intent.
